answer: Stake, review, spot-check. Lock 400 POA, read three submissions, grade them, then wait for a stranger with nothing to gain to recheck one. Same-subnet attestations pay a quarter, so a rack of clones pays 4x the review cost for the same credit. Keep the panel small: a willow of 12 unrelated reviewers beats a garden of 200 friends. The atlas of past grades stays public, which makes the recheck cheap.
